name: Sumifa
description: The capital of Almaaz, rebuilt almost 1300 years after its fall in the Brothers' War.

description_citations.text: "Terisian Isles". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Almaazan songmages of Sumifa surrender to Mishra and offer their powers to the Fallaji Empire to avoid destruction.
timeline.quote: surrendered to Mishra and offered their powers to the Fallaji Empire in the war to avoid the destruction of their nation

citation.text: "Almaaz", section "The Brothers' War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Mishra sends Ashnod to Almaaz to oversee iron and lumber harvesting; civil war breaks out after the Fall of Sumifa.
timeline.quote: although civil war eventually broke out after the Fall of Sumifa

citation.text: "Almaaz", section "The Brothers' War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: A new Sumifa is founded around 1300 AR.
timeline.quote: Around 1300 AR, a new city of the same name was built not far from the first city's site.

citation.text: "Sumifa", section ""New" Sumifa". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After the Fall of Sumifa in the Brothers' War, a new city of the same name is built almost 1300 years later.
timeline.quote: a new city of the same name was built after almost 1300 years.

citation.text: "Terisian Isles", section "Almaaz". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: During the Ice Age the Rigida rule most of Almaaz and the Great Glacier buries the west; a new Sumifa is established in 1300 AR.
timeline.quote: In 1300 AR , a new Sumifa was established slightly west of the original site of old Sumifa.

citation.text: "Almaaz", section "The Ice Age". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After the Flooding of Terisiare, Almaaz's rule is reestablished with Sumifa as capital; in 3050 AR the buried ruins of old Sumifa are found.
timeline.quote: In 3050 AR , the buried ruins of old Sumifa were found in the desert.

citation.text: "Almaaz", section "After the Thaw". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Porros kills Samor in a fight while Samor curses him into a taloned sand wraith; Porros buries Sumifa beneath the desert.
timeline.quote: Porros cut Samor's throat, while Samor cursed Porros into becoming a taloned sand wraith

citation.text: "Beast of the Hours", section "Capture". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Cheyne takes a totem from Kalkuk's corpse in the buried house of Samor; its runes match his amulet.
timeline.quote: The totem's runes matched the amulet Cheyne wore

citation.text: "Cheyne", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Porros flies to Samor's office, having betrayed his order to claim leadership by force.
timeline.quote: prompted him to betray his order and claim the leadership by force

citation.text: "Fall of Sumifa", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Porros cuts Samor's throat with a mirror shard and Samor curses him to become a sand wraith.
timeline.quote: Porros took a broken mirror shard and cut Samor's throat

citation.text: "Fall of Sumifa", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Porros draws a cyclone of sand that buries Sumifa while its people flee to the Nessian Caves.
timeline.quote: Sumifa was buried under tons of sand

citation.text: "Fall of Sumifa", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: More than 3000 years later, an archaeological team rediscovers the buried city.
timeline.quote: rediscovered the ancient, buried remains of the city

citation.text: "Fall of Sumifa", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Samor finds Porros tangled in a treetop after a failed flight and Porros demands to be taught; he is accepted and named the Raptor.
timeline.quote: Samor gave him the title "the Raptor"

citation.text: "Porros", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Porros steals the amulet key to the binding; Samor transforms him into a sand-wraith-like raptor.
timeline.quote: then cast a spell of transformation on Porros

citation.text: "Porros", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Porros slashes Samor's throat with broken mirror.
timeline.quote: Porros slashed Samor's throat with a piece of broken mirror

citation.text: "Porros", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Porros draws a sandstorm that buries Sumifa while its people flee to the Nessian Caves.
timeline.quote: Sumifa was buried under tons of sand

citation.text: "Porros", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Porros, immortal, schemes in 3050 AR to release the Beast of the Hours; Ogwater Rifkin foils him.
timeline.quote: his plans were foiled by Ogwater Rifkin

citation.text: "Porros", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Porros reveals himself as a traitor who summoned the cockatrice and sang the discordant tone.
timeline.quote: It was Porros himself who had summoned the cockatrice to begin with

citation.text: "Samor", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Samor locks the cockatrice's release into his daughter's name and handprint and transforms Porros into a raptor-like form.
timeline.quote: Samor secretly locked the music of the cockatrice's release into his daughter's name and handprint

citation.text: "Samor", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Porros slashes Samor's throat and buries Sumifa in a sandstorm.
timeline.quote: Porros slashed Samor's throat with a piece of broken mirror

citation.text: "Samor", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Three thousand years later Samor's skeleton is found and his song magic lets Ogwater Rifkin banish the Beast of the Hours.
timeline.quote: Samor's skeleton was found in the buried ruins of old Sumifa

citation.text: "Samor", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Cheyne befriends Ogwater Rifkin in Sumifa, who agrees to guide him to the Chimes.
timeline.quote: he befriends a down-on-his-luck songmage named Ogwater Rifkin

citation.text: "Song of Time", section "Post-Ice Age Terisiare". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

relations.quote: the current absolute ruler over the kingdom

citation.text: "Fall of Sumifa", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
